Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, west Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 115 s. 2022 October 6, 2022 HON. AMADO T. BABAO Punong Barangay Barangay Ilang, Bunawan Davao City Dear PB Babao: This has reference to the letter dated 6 September 2022 of Sangguniang Barangay (SB) Members Alvin Besinan, Lito Padilla, Magdalena Dicang and Susana Tulabing, requesting this Department's assistance to fill in the vacancy created in the Sangguniang Barangay of Ilang, Bunawan, Davao City. Per their letter, the antecedent facts are as follows: • SB Member Anita Diesta died on 28 December 2020. As a consequence of which, permanent vacancy arises in the Sangguniang Barangay of Barangay Ilang, Bunawan, Davao City. • As early as January 2021, they began to raise the issue of the vacant position. The SB Members nominated the next of kin of the late SB Member Diesta, her husband, Mr. Jerry Diesta. However, it was not acted upon up to this date. • Hence, they were compelled to seek advice from the Office of Davao City Mayor, however, then Mayor, Vice President Sara Duterte-Carpio informed them that she cannot act on the issue without resolution or endorsement coming from the Sangguniang Barangay nominating appointee to the vacant position. • Accordingly, they took the initiative to draft a resolution nominating Mr. Diesta. Allegedly, your Office ignored the same. Moreover, it came to their attention that you also directed the Barangay Secretary not to include this issue in the matters to be taken. Hence, the instant request for this Department's assistance to fill in the vacancy. In reply thereto, please be informed that the appointment to fill up a permanent vacancy upon recommendation of the sangguniang barangay in the herein case is mandatory. Section 45 of the Local Government Code of 1991 (LGC) finds application, thus: "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54 CamScanner

"SECTION 45. Permanent Vacancies in the Sanggunian. — (a) Permanent vacancies in the sanggunian where automatic succession provided above do not apply shall be filled by appointment in the following manner: (I) The President, through the Executive Secretary, in the case of the sangguniang panlalawigan and the sangguniang panlungsod of highly urbanized cities and independent component cities; (2) The governor, in the case of the sangguniang panlungsod of component cities and the sangguniang bayan; (3) The city or municipal mayor, in the case of sangguniang barangay, upon recommendation of the sangguniang barangay concerned. " It is categorical in the aforementioned provision that said appointment is mandatory by "...shall be filled by appointment in the the use of the word "shall" in the phrase following manner..." The recommendation of the concerned sangguiang barangay is also mandatory being an element in the process of the appointment by the city or municipal mayor. Since this duty is mandatory, then the Sangguniang Barangay, all the more you as the Punong Barangay, shall faithfully comply therewith. Otherwise, noncompliance shall be tantamount to dereliction of duty which is a ground for disciplinary action provided in Section 60 of the LGC. Hence, pursuant to the DILG Secretary's delegated power of general supervision over local government units and their officials, you are hereby directed to faithfully comply with your duties, specifically, to fill-up the vacancy created in the Sangguniang Barangay. We hope your utmost cooperation on the matter. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY HORITY OF THE SECR ATTY. VIC OR R.
